paper_title: No evidence for axions from Chandra observation of magnetic white dwarf
notes: Chandra X-ray observation of magnetic white dwarf RE J0317-853; non-observation of axion-induced X-rays (bremsstrahlung production via g_aee, conversion via g_agamma). Fundamental result is a product limit g_aee*g_agamma < 1.3e-25 GeV^-1 at 95% CL for m_a << 1e-5 eV. Translated to g_agamma assuming Caee = Cagamma: g_agamma <= 5.5e-13 GeV^-1 for m_a <~ 5e-6 eV (encoded here as a flat line over the plot's low-mass range 1e-11 to 5e-6 eV; the limit weakens at higher masses up to ~1e-2 eV per Fig. 1, but no numerical values given). A more conservative model-independent bound assuming only loop-induced W-phobic Caee = 1.6e-4*Cagamma gives g_agamma <~ 4.4e-11 GeV^-1. Astrophysical bound, no DM density assumption. Extraction confidence moderate because the emitted g_agamma values are model-dependent (Caee=Cagamma assumption) and mass dependence beyond 5e-6 eV is only shown in figures. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.7, 2))
